name: extract_dream_elements
description: Extracts the core emotional, spatial, and sensory elements from a dream description.

core_emotion.description: The dominant emotion of the dream

key_spaces.description: Main spatial elements or locations in the dream

sensory_details.description: Important sensory information (light, sound, texture, temperature, etc.)

physical_rules.description: How physics or gravity behaved in the dream

symbolic_objects.description: Important objects or symbols that appeared
